discussion.body: Board pack mapping. When FrameField can export a sequence, board in this order: FEAT-013 Act 0, FEAT-014 Act 1, FEAT-015 Act 2, FEAT-016 Act 3, FEAT-017 Act 4, FEAT-018 Act 5, FEAT-019 Act 6, FEAT-020 Act 7. Cast labels on frames use FEAT-027 through FEAT-036. Temple inserts use FEAT-021 through FEAT-026. Do not board until design says the draft is close. This chat still does not touch FrameField source.
